data.title: Tang Zhi Zhi Yi
data.synopsis:
A chance encounter between young Tang Zhi and a dragon maiden unexpectedly awakened his "Heavenly Eye"—allowing him to see gods and spirits roaming the mortal realm. These unique eyes led him into a world that coexisted with the mundane. Through unforgettable experiences, Tang Zhi made friends with all sorts of people and experienced laughter and warmth in seemingly ordinary yet subtly wondrous daily moments. An ordinary scholar, encountering and accompanying a group of gods and spirits with diverse personalities amidst the everyday life of the mortal world—this story of adventure, friendship, and growth is slowly unfolding.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

data.title: Metal Cardbot W
data.synopsis:
Shining friendship and strong claws! Metal Cardbot W!

After the Speranza incident, humans and Metal Cardbots began to coexist on Earth.
Jun, a boy chosen by the Metal Breath, and his partner Blue Cop discovered a way for humans and Metal Cardbots to coexist.
Then one day, a "Wild Cardbot" appears, holding a 60 million year secret.

Now, a new encounter begins to shake the world.

(Source: Metal Cardbot Wiki)

data.synopsis:
Nightmare Geese animated trailer by Masami Obari

Fates intertwine after more than 26 years as Rock Howard, Terry Bogard, and more vie for the legacy of the late Geese Howard, whose ghostly and nightmarish presence continues to haunt South Town. Experience the ominous aura of Nightmare Geese, and the intense action that ensues once the city’s heroes encounter him—all in the dynamic visual style that world-renowned animator Masami Obari does best.

(Source: YouTube)
data.background: This trailer took place after the epilogue of Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves video game.
